title: スプリンターズSの後に・次のカワイイ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes draws to a close…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Curren Chan's victory over Nishino Flower! However, the fact that she didn't overwhelm her in terms of cuteness dampens Curren Chan's excitement a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to town to find that Curren Chan's race with Nishino Flower has gone viral, launching her Umatter fame skyward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing how worked up everyone is gives Curren Chan a hint about what direction to go moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set the Takamatsunomiya Kinen as Curren Chan's next big goal and decide to run in the Ocean Stakes as a warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Nishino Flower's victory… Yet despite the loss, Curren Chan seems happy. She tells me this is proof that she can still become cuter.
